caption: The drawing depicts a single pair of eyeglasses centered on a plain, beige or off-white background. The eyeglasses have thin, black frames with octagonal lenses, and lightly shaded lenses that appear grayish-blue. The temples of the glasses are slender and curve outward, ending in small oval tips. The illustration is minimalistic with no other objects or decoration except for the artist's signature, "Frank Nelson," located at the bottom right corner. The overall composition is sparse, with the glasses occupying a small area centrally on the otherwise empty background.
title: Spectacles
